segments.text: In this world, there are invisible borders of many kinds.
Some are clear, like national borders.
Others are invisible walls within society.
One of these is the cycle of poverty
A child born into a poor family has limited educational opportunities
Cannot get a good job and even as an adult cannot escape from poverty
This is passed on from one generation to the next generation
To break this cycle requires the effort of society as a whole
Education, medical care, housing, job training
Through one individual's strength alone, it is difficult to escape poverty
Bangladesh's Grammy and Bank created a new scheme against poverty
Microfinance, small loans to low-income people
Money is lent even without collateral
The repayment rate is surprisingly high
Demonstrated that poor people are not lazy
Giving only the chance they succeed through their own power
The founder, Muhammad Yunus, received the Nobel Peace Prize in 2006
Unis argued that poverty reflects social systems rather than personal failure
Meanwhile, in developed countries too, a new poverty has emerged
The working poor who can only make ends meet despite long hours
A divide in education caused by parents' income
Poverty not only torments those who experience it
But also blocks the development of society
As a whole
A society in which every person can make use of their talent
Is a sustainable society
This is not a distant story Beside us, even now
Someone is fighting against poverty What we can do
For each one of us to think about it Is the first step
